---
title: "Metaweb Assembly Simulations"
output: html_document
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Variability of the metrics of each food web estimated with the metaweb
assembly model (package `meweasmo`):

1. Simulate the model over a Latin hypercube of parameters (m, a, se).
2. Select the parameters that reproduce the observed number of species and
   connectance (approximate Bayesian computation).
3. Simulate 1,000 local food webs per site with the selected parameters and
   compute their metrics (modularity with Infomap; a second run with spinglass
   is used only in `R/CompareModularityAlgorithms.R`).
4. Figures S3 to S5 (simulated vs empirical metrics), Figure S6 (correlation
   between predictors) and Table S1.

Reads `Data/network_info.rds` (complete, after `HalpernHumanImpact.Rmd` and
`Stabilitysimulations.Rmd`) and `Data/stability_results_meig.rds` (Table S1).
The simulation chunks are `eval = FALSE` because they take hours; their results
are saved in `Data/`.

## Setup

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

required_packages <- c(
  "lhs", "purrr", "igraph", "ggplot2", "tibble", "future", "future.apply", "devtools", "abc",
  "tidyverse", "viridisLite", "patchwork", "GGally", "xtable"
)
for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
  require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Install meweasmo from GitHub if not installed
if (!requireNamespace("meweasmo", quietly = TRUE)) {
  devtools::install_github("lsaravia/meweasmo")
}
library(meweasmo)

# Install multiweb from GitHub if not installed
if (!requireNamespace("multiweb", quietly = TRUE)) {
  devtools::install_github("lsaravia/multiweb")
}
library(multiweb)

source("R/network_fun.r")

network_info <- readRDS("Data/network_info.rds")
```

## Simulate the metaweb assembly model

```{r simulMetaWeb, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# Parameter ranges: rows are m, a, se
par_ranges <- matrix(c(0.01, 0.3, 0.001, 0.5, 0.1, 0.9), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
nsims <- 10000
model_type <- 1

run_simulation_for_network <- function(g, net_name) {
  A <- igraph::as_adjacency_matrix(g, sparse = FALSE)
  sim_metaWebAssembly_lhs(3, nsims, par_ranges, A, model_type) %>%
    mutate(model_type = "Continuous", model = "Prob", Metaweb = net_name)
}

simMetaWebAssembly <- purrr::map2_dfr(network_info$igraph, network_info$site, run_simulation_for_network)

saveRDS(simMetaWebAssembly, "Data/simulations_metaWebAssembly_all_networks.rds")
```

## Fit the metaweb assembly model

```{r FitMetaWebAssembly, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
simMetaWebAssembly <- readRDS("Data/simulations_metaWebAssembly_all_networks.rds")

all_results_list <- purrr::pmap(
  list(emp_S = network_info$S, emp_C = network_info$C, web_name = network_info$site),
  function(emp_S, emp_C, web_name) {
    CI_metaWebAssembly_model(emp_S, emp_C, web_name, simMetaWebAssembly)
  }
)

fittedMetaWeb <- purrr::map_dfr(all_results_list, "sel")
gof_rej_df    <- purrr::map_dfr(all_results_list, "gof")

saveRDS(fittedMetaWeb, "Data/fittedMetaWeb_all_networks.rds")
saveRDS(gof_rej_df, "Data/gof_all_networks.rds")
```

## Simulate local food webs and calculate their metrics

```{r simMetaWebMetrics, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
fittedMetaWeb <- readRDS("Data/fittedMetaWeb_all_networks.rds")

simulate_all_sites <- function(modularity_method) {
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(network_info$site), function(i) {
    message("Simulating for site: ", network_info$site[i])
    simulate_metaweb_metrics(as_adjacency_matrix(network_info$igraph[[i]], sparse = FALSE),
                             fittedMetaWeb, network_info$site[i], nsim = 1000,
                             modularity_method = modularity_method)
  }) %>%
    mutate(relRank = Rank / S)
}

# Infomap: used in all the analyses
simMetaWebMetrics <- simulate_all_sites("infomap")
saveRDS(simMetaWebMetrics, "Data/simulations_metaWeb_metrics.rds")

# Spinglass: only for the comparison in R/CompareModularityAlgorithms.R
simMetaWebMetrics_sg <- simulate_all_sites("spinglass")
saveRDS(simMetaWebMetrics_sg, "Data/simulations_metaWeb_metrics_spinglass.rds")
```

## Figures S3 to S5: simulated vs empirical metrics

```{r plotMetaWebMetrics, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
simMetaWebMetrics <- readRDS("Data/simulations_metaWeb_metrics.rds") %>%
  filter(Metaweb %in% network_info$site) %>%
  mutate(SVDComplexity = 1 - Entropy, RankDeficiency = 1 - relRank)

save_density_figure <- function(metrics, file) {
  plot_list <- plot_density_faceted_by_site(network_info, simMetaWebMetrics, metrics = metrics)
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2, guides = "collect", axes = "collect_x") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave(file, plot = combined_plot, height = 6, width = 10, bg = "white")
  combined_plot
}

save_density_figure(c("C", "RankDeficiency"), "Figures/empirical_vs_simulated_metrics_C_RD.png")
save_density_figure(c("SVDComplexity", "Modularity"), "Figures/empirical_vs_simulated_metrics_SVDC_Mod.png")
save_density_figure(c("LD", "TLmean"), "Figures/empirical_vs_simulated_metrics_LD_TL.png")
```

## Figure S6: correlations between predictors

```{r CheckCorrelation, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
network_info %>%
  mutate(log_area = log(area_km2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(temp_C, S, latitude, log_area, impact_mean, depth_m) %>%
  ggpairs(
    upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor", size = 4)),
    lower = list(continuous = wrap("points", alpha = 0.7, size = 3)),
    diag = list(continuous = wrap("densityDiag", alpha = 0.5))
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("Figures/correlation_network_info.png", width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Table S1: metrics of the simulated food webs

```{r createTable, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE, results='asis'}
# Mean and 95% interval, stacked inside a single LaTeX cell
summarize_metric <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  m   <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  lwr <- quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  upr <- quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  sprintf("\\shortstack{%0.*f \\\\ {\\tiny(%0.*f--%0.*f)}}",
          digits, m, digits, lwr, digits, upr)
}

stability_results_meig <- readRDS("Data/stability_results_meig.rds")

summary_table <- simMetaWebMetrics %>%
  rename(site = Metaweb) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    C = summarize_metric(C),
    LD = summarize_metric(LD),
    TLmean = summarize_metric(TLmean),
    SVDComplexity = summarize_metric(SVDComplexity),
    RankDeficiency = summarize_metric(RankDeficiency),
    Modularity = summarize_metric(Modularity),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(stability_results_meig %>% group_by(site) %>% summarise(Meig = summarize_metric(MEing_stable)),
             by = "site")

print(
  xtable(summary_table,
         caption = "Summary of network metrics across 1000 simulations for each metaweb. Values are means with 95\\% intervals in parentheses.",
         label = "tab:metaweb_metrics",
         align = c("l","l","c","c","c","c","c","c","c")),
  include.rownames = FALSE,
  sanitize.text.function = identity,
  booktabs = TRUE
)
```
